full_judgment: 3. It has been further stated that the petitioner lodged a General Diary being GD No. 1162 dated 27-2-2001 with the Cantonment Police Station, Dhaka. A criminal case being Cantonment Police Station Case No.2 dated 5-3-2001 was also filed against the petitioner under section 16(32) of the Customs Act, 1969 read with section 3(1) of the Import Export Act, 1950 and section 8(1) of the Foreign Exchange Regulation Act, 1947 (Annexure- D and D-1).
